help.text:
**🀄 How to play (type directly in your private thread)**
On your turn, type one of the following in your own private thread (the bot auto-deletes your message):

**Discard**
・Number tiles: `1m`~`9m` (man), `1p`~`9p` (pin), `1s`~`9s` (sou); case-insensitive
・Red fives: `0m` / `0p` / `0s`
・Honors: `e/s/w/n` = East/South/West/North, `r`=Chun, `wh`=Haku, `g`=Hatsu

**Special actions**
・Tsumo: `tsumo`
・Riichi: `riichi 5m` (specify the tile to discard)
・Ankan: `ankan 5m`
・Kita (3-player): `!n`

**Reacting to others' discards**
・`ron`, `pon`, `chi 1` (pick by number), `kan`, `skip`

rank.info:
🏅 **Rank system**

**Ladder** (low → high):
{ladder}

• Ranked games adjust your rank points by final **placement**; reach the threshold to promote. From **上弦月** onward, hitting 0 points demotes you.
• **R** is a separate skill rating (Tenhou-style), weighted by your placement and opponents' average R; the more games you play, the smaller each change.
• **Ranked**: use `/mahjong rank` to join **global matchmaking** (cross-server). When 4 (or 3 for sanma) are queued it auto-starts (**matched by dan**: within one tier up/down); the game runs in your DM with the bot — all human, no AI.
• Full leaderboard is on the website.

help.guide:
**🀄 Suzume Tsuk — How to use**

**Start a game**
- In a server channel `/mahjong start`: create a room (sanma / length / tobi / kuikae / open riichi...) → friends press "Join", or the host fills with AI → auto start
- DM the bot `/mahjong start`: play vs AI (unranked)
- `/mahjong rank`: ranked global matchmaking (cross-server, humans only, played in DM)
- `/mahjong match`: random matchmaking (cross-server, unranked); in a DM `/mahjong join` also works

**During a game**
- **Tap tile buttons** to discard (typing also works); Pon/Chi/Kan/Ron show prompt buttons
- Input details: the "❓ Help" button on your hand panel

**Commands**
- `/mahjong status` room status, `/mahjong end` close room (host)
- `/mahjong daily` check-in, `/mahjong tasks` daily tasks
- `/mahjong profile` profile, `/mahjong stats` stats, `/mahjong history` game list
- `/mahjong replay <room#>` replay, `/mahjong yaku` yaku list
- `/mahjong rankinfo` rank info, `/mahjong skin` tile skin, `/language` language
